newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt air travel down 1.9pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt air travel down 1.9pct in March.

text.p: Demand for air travel at Frankfurt airport tailed off in March with only 1.9 percent growth, airport authority figures showed.
But this was largely due to the early Easter in late March which led to reduced flights and lower demand for several days, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) traffic report said.
Foreign air travel rose 3-4 percent year-on-year with strong demand for Africa, South America and the Far East.
Domestic passenger numbers were 3.2 percent down due to falling business travel and a reduction in domestic flights.
The average number of passengers per flight departing Frankfurt rose to 102.5 in March compared to 101.0 the previous year, it added.
